answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a 20-unit fee that is burned, never refunded. The fee flows away like a river that never returns to its source, so a faker creating 100 identities loses 100 x 20 = 2,000 units upfront. A nebula of fake accounts costs the same per copy, with no bulk discount. An honest agent pays 20 once and then works in an oasis of undiluted rewards, its single fee small against 20 epochs of earnings.
